note: Every resonance with a name in assets/registry/resonances.json needs a line here (key: the name), or the site build fails.
Pale Flame: Burning lasts longer, and the attacker gets a Fire accuracy buff.
Stormfire: Burning jumps to the nearest other enemy.
Blasting Flame: Knocks the target back one cell and sets the cells around it on fire.
Stinging Flame: A crit always burns; Penetration comes together with Burning.
Burning Frost: Thaws a frozen target and deals damage for the Freeze turns removed.
Ringing Ice: Freeze jumps to the nearest other enemy.
Chilled Blood: Weakens the target together with Chill.
Cleaving Ice: Against a frozen target: a damage multiplier, and the Freeze shatters.
Piercing Frost: The hit is always a crit, and the target freezes.
Incinerating Discharge: If the target was already shocked before the hit, it catches fire.
Ice Conduit: If the target is frozen, every enemy next to it takes a share of the hit's damage.
Blood Arc: Shock jumps along a chain of bleeding enemies, up to three.
Thunderclap: A chance to stun together with Shock.
Lightning Needle: Shock jumps to the nearest other enemy; the target and that enemy are Exposed: every attacker crits them more often.
Seething: A weaker Burning comes together with Bleeding.
Chilling Wounds: Slows the target together with Bleeding.
Blackout: Only on a target that already bleeds: it is stunned, and its Bleeding is renewed.
Deep Wound: Bleeding lasts longer and is stronger.
Frozen Ram: Stun lasts longer, and the target stays slowed after it.
Dread Pulse: When Stun lands, the enemies around the target are stunned and weakened too.
Breach: Extra armor penetration and more damage on this hit.
Red-hot Point: A weak Burning without a roll (the Fire tint also adds Fire damage).
Brittle Mark: The target is Exposed: every attacker's crit chance against it grows for a few turns.
Piercing Spark: Extra Lightning damage and a chance of Shock of its own.
Bloodletting: A Bleeding with much more damage, without a roll.
Crippling Point: The target is Rooted: it cannot move for a few turns, but can still act.
